title: NS Clipper v1.1.8
release_notes: NS Clipper v1.1.8: Stability fixes for PyAV scrub-preview crash; context-aware Auto Subject Tracking for cooking/product videos; static avatar/logo rejection; faster AV1 action-trajectory scanning. Supersedes v1.1.7.
changelog:
## Stability
- Fixed a critical Qt/PyAV scrub-preview crash when decoding portrait or padded video frames.
- Added safe QImage buffer conversion for non-contiguous PyAV frames.
- Improved project switching and scrub-worker safety.

## Auto Subject Tracking
- Added context-aware tracking for cooking, product, and hands-only videos.
- Added action-area framing for portrait crops.
- Automatically rejects static corner avatars, logos, and watermark graphics.
- Ensured playback preview, timeline scrubbing, and export use the same crop trajectory.

## Performance
- Faster AV1 action-trajectory scanning via bundled FFmpeg with safe OpenCV fallback.
- Improved trajectory reuse during application session.
- Preserved NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF, and CPU export fallback behavior.

## Compatibility
- Existing v1.1.5, v1.1.6, and v1.1.7 installations update through the full installer.
- Patch archives remain internal.
